# CANDIDATE: BEARISH_REJECTION_VIX_FILTER

**Filed:** 2026-07-21  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** filter_change  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Adding a VIX>20 requirement at entry for BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON will filter out low-VIX false breaks that lead to losses, particularly on non-J days, while preserving the three J anchor day winners which occurred in elevated VIX environments (4/29 VIX~24, 5/01 VIX~22, 5/04 VIX~31). This should improve edge_capture by reducing losing trades without sacrificing winners.

## Mechanism

Entry trigger remains BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON (level rejection + EMA ribbon flip + confluence). Add a pre-entry filter: require VIX > 20.0 (from real-time CBOE VIX feed) at the trigger bar close. If VIX <= 20.0, skip the setup entirely. All other rules (strike selection, stops, targets, position sizing) unchanged.

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** qty=28 requires $25K+ account; $1K paper account ~= 14% headline P&L (per risk-rules.md position sizing schedule).
2. **Sample bias:** Proposed filter based on playbook VIX guidance and manual inspection of J days (n=3 winners, n=3 losers). High overfit risk due to small anchor day sample; requires walk-forward OOS validation.
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (no OOS test performed yet).
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (no real-fills replay on anchor days performed yet).
5. **Failure modes:** 
   - Worst day: VIX>20 filter may skip valid breakdowns in VIX 18-20 range, turning potential winners into scratch trades.
   - Max drawdown: Could increase if filter causes whipsaw entries/exits during VIX mean-reversion periods.
   - Blow-up scenario: Persistent low-VIX regime (VIX<15) where filter rejects all entries, causing strategy to sit idle while market trends (opportunity cost not drawdown).
6. **Concentration:** If top-5 days = X% of P&L, state X: unknown -- requires Stage-1 backtest (prior BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON showed concentration on 5/04 extreme day).
